hindi: देव सविता की प्रेरणा में, अश्विनों की भुजाओं से और पूषा के हाथों से मैं तुम्हें ग्रहण करता हूँ। तुम नारी हो; यहाँ मैं राक्षसों की गर्दनें काटता हूँ। तुम यव हो; हमसे द्वेषों को दूर करो, शत्रु-शक्तियों को दूर करो। द्युलोक के लिए तुम्हें, अन्तरिक्ष के लिए तुम्हें, पृथ्वी के लिए तुम्हें। पितरों के आसन वाले लोक शुद्ध हों। तुम पितरों का आसन हो।
english: At the impulse of the god Savitṛ, with the arms of the two Aśvins and the hands of Pūṣan, I take you. You are a woman; here I cut off the necks of the demons. You are barley; keep hatreds away from us, keep hostile powers away. You for heaven, you for the atmosphere, you for the earth. May the worlds, the seats of the fathers, be purified. You are the seat of the fathers.
notes: Unit holds three printed lines; kept as given. 'nāryasīdamaham' read as nārī asi idam aham; the line does not say who or what is addressed as 'woman'. The object of 'I take' is only tvā 'you'.

यवो॑ऽसि य॒वया॒स्मद्  द्वेषो॑ य॒वयारा॑तीर्दि॒वे त्वा॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षाय त्वा पृथि॒व्यै त्वा॒ शुन्ध॑न्ताँल्लो॒काः पि॑तृ॒षद॑नाः
पि॑तृ॒षद॑नमसि

hindi: तुम अग्रगामी हो; हे सुगम प्रवेश वाले, उन्नेताओं के इस विषय में जानो। तुम पर कोई खड़ा होगा। देव सविता तुम्हें मधु से अभिषिक्त करें, उत्तम फल वाली ओषधियों के लिए तुम्हें। तुमने अग्र भाग से द्युलोक को छुआ, मध्य भाग से अन्तरिक्ष को भर दिया, निचले भाग से पृथ्वी को दृढ़ किया।
english: You are the leader; O you of good entry, take note of this of the unnetṛs. One will stand upon you. May the god Savitṛ anoint you with honey, you for the plants with good fruit. With your tip you touched heaven, with your middle you filled the atmosphere, with your lower part you made the earth firm.
notes: Obscure: 'svāveśa' taken as vocative 'of good entry' (could be nominative); 'vittāt' as imperative 'know'; 'supippalābhyaḥ' as 'good-fruited' (not identified as a plant). The subject of 'sthāsyati' is not stated. Who is addressed as tvā is not stated.

द्यामग्रे॑णास्पृक्ष॒ आन्तरि॑क्षं॒ मध्ये॑नाप्राः पृथि॒वीमुप॑रेणादृᳪहीः

hindi: तुम्हारे जिन निवासों को हम पाना चाहते हैं, जहाँ बहुत सींगों वाली फुर्तीली गायें हैं, वहाँ उरुगाय विष्णु का वह परम पद निश्चय ही भरपूर नीचे लाया गया है। हे ब्रह्म को जीतने वाली, क्षत्र को जीतने वाली, धन और पुष्टि को जीतने वाली, मैं तुम्हें चारों ओर रखता हूँ। ब्रह्म को दृढ़ करो, क्षत्र को दृढ़ करो, आयु को दृढ़ करो, प्रजा को दृढ़ करो।
english: Those abodes of yours that we desire to reach, where the many-horned nimble cows are: there indeed the highest step of wide-striding Viṣṇu has been abundantly borne down. O you who win priestly power, who win ruling power, who win wealth and prosperity, I place you around. Make firm the priestly power, make firm the ruling power, make firm life, make firm offspring.
notes: Obscure: 'ayāsaḥ' glossed 'nimble' (doubtful); 'bhāri' is the printed form (the Ṛgveda parallel has 'bhāti'); not changed, rendered 'has been borne down'. 'brahmavani' etc. taken as vocatives addressed to tvā (case uncertain); 'brahma' as priestly power. 'paryūhāmi' translated 'I place around'.
lines_deva: या ते॒ धामा॑न्यु॒श्मसि॒ गम॑ध्यै॒ यत्र॒ गावो॒ भूरि॑शृङ्गा अ॒यास॑ः । अत्राह॒ तदु॑रुगा॒यस्य॒ विष्णो॑ः पर॒मं प॒दमव॑ भारि॒ भूरि॑
ब्र॒ह्म॒वनि॑ त्वा क्षत्र॒वनि॑ रायस्पोष॒वनि॒ पर्यू॑हामि । ब्रह्म॑ दृᳪह क्ष॒त्रं दृ॒ᳪहायु॑र्दृᳪह प्र॒जां दृ॑ᳪह

english: Look at the rites of Viṣṇu, from which he has beheld the observances, Indra's fitting friend.
notes: 'paspaśe' taken as 3 sg. perfect of √spaś 'behold'; the subject is not stated beyond 'friend of Indra'.

hindi: विष्णु के उस परम पद को ज्ञानी सदा देखते हैं, आकाश में फैली हुई आँख के समान।
english: The wise ones always see that highest step of Viṣṇu, like an eye spread out in the sky.
notes: Token '|di̱vī̱va̱' carries a stray bar attached; kept as given.

hindi: तुम घेरने वाले हो। दैवी प्रजाएँ तुम्हें चारों ओर से लपेट लें, इस यजमान को मनुष्यों के धन चारों ओर से घेर लें। तुम द्युलोक के पुत्र हो। पृथ्वी पर यह तुम्हारा लोक है। जंगली पशु तुम्हारा पशु है।
english: You are the encircler. May the divine clans wrap around you, and around this sacrificer the riches of men. You are the son of heaven. This is your world on the earth. The wild animal is your animal.

english: You are the one who approaches; the divine clans, the eager ones, went forth to the gods, the best bearers. O god Tvaṣṭṛ, take delight in the good things; may the offerings be sweet to you.
notes: Obscure: 'prāguḥ' (token 'prāgṷru̱śijo̱' read prāguḥ uśijaḥ) is kept untranslated; 'upāvīḥ' glossed 'one who approaches' (doubtful); 'vasu' taken as good things; 'svadantām' as 'be sweet'. The relation of the accusatives to 'asi' is not clear. 'prāguḥ' is read as the verb pra-aguḥ ('went forth'); the construction of the accusatives and nominatives around it is uncertain.

hindi: हे धनवतियो, रमण करो; हे बृहस्पति, धनों को धारण करो। हे देवों के हव्य, मैं तुम्हें ऋत के पाश से बाँधता हूँ। धर्षा, मानुष।
english: O wealthy ones, take delight; O Bṛhaspati, hold the goods. O offering of the gods, I fasten you with the cord of order. Dharṣā, the human.
notes: Obscure: the end 'dharṣā mānuṣaḥ' is left untranslated as 'dharṣā' (form and sense uncertain; possibly an imperative of √dhṛṣ); 'revatīḥ' taken as vocative plural; 'dhārayā' with lengthened final vowel read as an imperative. 'vasūni' rendered 'goods'.

english: At the impulse of the god Savitṛ, with the arms of the two Aśvins and the hands of Pūṣan, I yoke you, pleasing to Agni and Soma. You for the waters, you for the plants. May the mother consent to you, the father, the brother of the same womb, the friend of the same herd. I sprinkle you, pleasing to Agni and Soma.
notes: 'agnīṣomābhyām juṣṭam' taken as 'pleasing to Agni and Soma' (dative dual form). 'anu ... manyatām' read as 'consent' with 'anu' repeated for each person. The object of 'ni yunajmi' (and 'prokṣāmi' has tvā) is not printed in the first clause; 'you' is supplied.

english: You are the peru of the waters. May the divine waters sweeten the well-eaten offering to the gods, even as it is. May your breath unite with the wind, your limbs with the worshipful ones, and the lord of the sacrifice with the blessing.

english: You two, anointed with ghee, protect the animals; O wealthy one, place what is dear in the sacrificer and enter. From the wide atmosphere, in company with the divine wind, sacrifice by yourself of this offering; be one with this one's body. O varṣa, in the greater sacrifice set the lord of the sacrifice. Svāhā to the gods; to the gods svāhā.

hindi: जलों को और ओषधियों को हानि मत पहुँचाओ। हे राजन् वरुण, हर धाम से, उस से हमें छुड़ाओ। जो वे कहते हैं, अघ्न्या, और हे वरुण, इस प्रकार हम शपथ या शाप देते हैं, उससे हे वरुण हमें छुड़ाओ। जल और ओषधियाँ हमारे लिए मित्रवत हों; जो हमसे द्वेष करता है और जिससे हम द्वेष करते हैं, उसके लिए वे शत्रुवत हों।
english: Do not harm the waters, do not harm the plants. From each abode, O king, from there, O Varuṇa, release us. What they say, 'aghnyā', and 'O Varuṇa!', thus we swear; from that, O Varuṇa, release us. May the waters and plants be friendly to us; may they be unfriendly to him who hates us and whom we hate.
notes: The reading of 'dhāmno dhāmno rājaṃs tataḥ' and of 'yad āhur aghnyā iti varuṇeti śapāmahe' is uncertain ('aghnyā' left untranslated in both languages; 'śapāmahe' could be 'we swear' or 'we curse'). 'yosmān' is printed without avagraha.

hindi: अग्नि के, जिसका घर गिरा नहीं है, आसन में मैं तुम्हें बैठाता हूँ। तुम इन्द्र और अग्नि के भाग हो; तुम मित्र और वरुण के भाग हो; तुम सब देवों के भाग हो। वे जो सूर्य के समीप हैं, या जिनके साथ सूर्य है, वे हमारे अनुष्ठान को आगे बढ़ाएँ।
english: In the seat of Agni of the unfallen house I seat you. You are the portions of Indra and Agni; you are the portions of Mitra and Varuṇa; you are the portions of all the gods. Those that are near Sūrya, or with which Sūrya is together, may they speed our rite.
notes: 'apannagṛha' is rendered 'whose house has not fallen' (sense of apanna doubtful). 'bhāgadheyī' rendered 'portion'. The line does not say what 'you' and 'those' refer to.

english: O Soma, O king, descend upon all creatures; let all creatures descend to you. Let Agni hear my call with the kindling; let the waters and the divine dhiṣaṇās hear. O pressing stones, listen to the sacrifice like those who know; let the god Savitṛ hear my call. Svāhā.

śye̱nāya̭ tvā soma̱bhṛte̱  'gnayḙ tvā rāyaspoṣa̱de

hindi: हे सोम, तुम्हारी जो ज्योति द्युलोक में है, जो पृथ्वी पर है, जो विस्तृत अन्तरिक्ष में है, उससे इस यजमान के लिए धन हेतु विस्तार करो; दाता के पक्ष में बोलो।
english: The light of yours, O Soma, that is in heaven, that on earth, that in the wide atmosphere: with that make wide for this sacrificer, for wealth; speak on behalf of the giver.
notes: 'uru kṛdhi' read as 'make wide' (object not stated); 'adhi vocaḥ' as 'speak on behalf of'. 'urau' taken with antarikṣe.
lines_deva: यत्ते॑ सोम दि॒वि ज्योति॒र्यत्पृ॑थि॒व्यां यदु॒राव॒न्तरि॑क्षे । तेनास्मै॒ यज॑मानायो॒रु रा॒ये कृ॒ध्यधि॑ दा॒त्रे वो॑चः
lines_iast: yattḙ soma di̱vi jyoti̱ryatpṛ̭thi̱vyāṃ yadu̱rāva̱ntari̭kṣe | tenāsmai̱ yaja̭mānāyo̱ru rā̱ye kṛ̱dhyadhi̭ dā̱tre vo̭caḥ

hindi: तुम तेज़ हो, वृत्र को जीतने वाली, दान से स्वागत की गई, अमर की पत्नियाँ हो। हे देवियो, देवों के बीच इस यज्ञ को ले चलो; बुलाई हुई तुम सोम का पान करो।
english: You are swift, overcoming vṛtra, welcomed by bounty, the wives of the immortal. O divine ones, lead this sacrifice among the gods; invited, drink of Soma.
notes: Obscure: 'rādhogūrtāḥ' (rendered 'welcomed by bounty'); 'vṛtraturaḥ' rendered 'overcoming vṛtra' without identifying a being; 'devīḥ' rendered 'divine ones' and 'patnīḥ' 'wives' without adding who they are; 'somasya pibata' rendered 'drink of Soma'.
lines_deva: श्वा॒त्रा स्थ॑ वृत्र॒तुरो॒ राधो॑गूर्ता अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ पत्नी॑ः । ता दे॑वीर्देव॒त्रेमं य॒ज्ञं न॑य॒तोप॑हूता॒ः सोम॑स्य पिबत
lines_iast: śvā̱trā stha̭ vṛtra̱turo̱ rādho̭gūrtā a̱mṛta̭sya̱ patnī̭ḥ | tā dḙvīrdeva̱tremaṃ ya̱jñaṃ na̭ya̱topa̭hūtā̱ḥ soma̭sya pibata

hindi: डरो मत, काँपो मत; बल धारण करो। हे दोनों धिषणा, दृढ़ होती हुई दृढ़ करो और बल धारण करो। पाप मारा गया है, सोम नहीं।
english: Do not fear, do not tremble; hold vigour. O two dhiṣaṇās, being firm, make firm and hold vigour. Evil is slain, not Soma.
notes: 'dhiṣaṇe' (dual) left as a transliterated, uncertain term. 'na' in the last line read as 'not' ('evil is slain, not Soma'); 'like' is possible. The line does not say who is addressed with 'mā bheḥ'.
lines_deva: मा भे॒र्मा सं वि॑क्था॒ ऊर्जं॑ धत्स्व॒ धिष॑णे वी॒ड्वी स॒ती वी॑डयेथा॒मूर्जं॑ दधाथाम् । पा॒प्मा ह॒तो न सोम॑ः
lines_iast: mā bhe̱rmā saṃ vi̭kthā̱ ūrja̭ṃ dhatsva̱ dhiṣa̭ṇe vī̱ḍvī sa̱tī vī̭ḍayethā̱mūrja̭ṃ dadhāthām | pā̱pmā ha̱to na soma̭ḥ

hindi: आगे, दूर, ऊपर, नीचे, सब ओर से दिशाएँ तुम्हारी ओर दौड़ें। हे माता, निष्पर; समरी को मैं पाऊँ।
english: Forward, away, upward, lower, from all sides let the directions run toward you. O mother, niṣpara; may I find the samarī.
notes: Obscure and low confidence: 'niṣpara' and 'samarīḥ' are left transliterated; 'vidām' read as 'may I find'. The four direction words are rendered literally (the line names no directions).
lines_deva: प्रागपा॒गुद॑गध॒राक्स॒र्वत॑स्त्वा॒ दिश॒ आ धा॑वन्तु । अम्ब॒ निष्प॑र॒ सम॒रीर्वि॑दाम्
lines_iast: prāgapā̱guda̭gadha̱rāksa̱rvata̭stvā̱ diśa̱ ā dhā̭vantu | amba̱ niṣpa̭ra̱ sama̱rīrvi̭dām

hindi: हे सर्वाधिक बलवान देव, तुम निश्चय ही मनुष्य की प्रशंसा करते हो। हे मघवन्, तुमसे अन्य कोई दयालु नहीं है; हे इन्द्र, मैं तुमसे ये वचन कहता हूँ।
english: You indeed, O god, most mighty, praise a mortal. There is no other than you, O bounteous one, who shows mercy; O Indra, I speak these words to you.
notes: 'praśaṃsiṣaḥ' read as 'you praise' (injunctive). 'marḍitā' rendered 'one who shows mercy'. 'devaḥ' is nominative, not vocative.
lines_deva: त्वम॒ङ्ग प्रश॑ᳪसिषो दे॒वः श॑विष्ठ॒ मर्त्य॑म् । न त्वद॒न्यो म॑घवन्नस्ति मर्डि॒तेन्द्र॒ ब्रवी॑मि ते॒ वच॑ः
lines_iast: tvama̱ṅga praśa̭ᳪsiṣo de̱vaḥ śa̭viṣṭha̱ martya̭m | na tvada̱nyo ma̭ghavannasti marḍi̱tendra̱ bravī̭mi te̱ vaca̭ḥ
